news.title: Grande Cup final set for Pioneer Cup final rematch
news.body: The inaugural Grande Cup final will see Black Bird United face Kolkata Kous, recreating the Pioneer Cup 2026A final between Anish and Bhavesh. Black Bird United previously defeated Kolkata Kous 2-0 on penalties after a 3-3 draw in the Pioneer Cup final.

news.title: CASPER expands with Conference League and Peripheral Cup
news.body: CASPER launched two new four-player single round-robin competitions, the Conference League and Peripheral Cup, expanding the federation's competitive calendar beyond its knockout competitions.

news.title: Peripheral Cup enters ongoing stage
news.body: The inaugural Peripheral Cup began with Romano United, Inter Grande CF, New Athletico Saltlake and Modo FC competing in a four-player single round-robin.

news.title: Black Bird United demolish Super Strikers CF 8-0 in The Derby
news.body: Black Bird United produced a historic performance in The Derby, defeating Srinjoy's Super Strikers CF 8-0. The eight-goal victory became the largest winning margin recorded in CASPER history, surpassing BBU's previous record of a 7-1 victory over Movile.

news.title: Black Bird United demolish Movile 7-1 in Grande quarter-final
news.body: Black Bird United produced a dominant display in the Grande quarter-finals, defeating Movile 7-1. The six-goal victory became the largest winning margin recorded in CASPER history at the time.

news.title: The Derby returns in Grande semi-final
news.body: Black Bird United faced Srinjoy's Super Strikers CF in The Derby, renewing the rivalry after their previous meeting in the Pioneer Cup quarter-finals, where Black Bird United prevailed 4-2.

news.title: Grande delivers dramatic quarter-finals
news.body: The inaugural Grande Cup opened with two extraordinary quarter-finals. Bhavesh recovered from 2-0 down before equalising again at 3-3 in stoppage time, while Arjun erased a 3-0 deficit in the final 45 seconds before being eliminated 3-2 on penalties.

news.title: Black Bird United lift inaugural Chroma Super Cup
news.body: Pioneer Cup champions Black Bird United defeated Relegator Cup winners New Athletico Saltlake 7-3 in the first-ever Chroma Super Cup, defeating Vyom and securing the federation's inaugural super cup title.

news.title: New Athletico Saltlake crowned first Relegator Cup champions
news.body: New Athletico Saltlake defeated Modo FC 3-2 in the inaugural Relegator Cup final, with Vyom becoming the first player to win CASPER's secondary knockout competition.

news.title: Black Bird United crowned inaugural Pioneer Cup champions
news.body: Black Bird United became the first Pioneer Cup champions after defeating Kolkata Kous in a dramatic penalty shootout following a 3-3 draw in the final. The tournament featured 12 clubs across four groups.

news.title: Pioneer Cup group stage concludes
news.body: Black Bird United, Vostok CF, Kolkata Kous and Martians topped their respective groups to advance into the knockout stage. Group A produced the tournament's highest-scoring football, while Group D featured a thrilling 5-4 encounter between Inter Grande CF and Movile.

news.title: CASPER era begins with inaugural Pioneer Cup
news.body: Competitive Athletics & Sports Promotion (CASPER) officially launched with the opening of the Pioneer Cup 2026A. Twelve clubs entered the federation's first competition, featuring a group stage followed by seeded knockout rounds.
